actual_scope: Optimal mean-length binary prefix labels for the cited rank-two, step-two P104 signature profile, with pathwise length-preserving code-only updates.
scope_change_reason: Change fixed-width labels to binary prefix codes and assume an initially uniform period-coset source. This is a finite storage side result, not a new helper split or supplier.
bottleneck_link: A nonlinear defect label can save average storage only under a stated source distribution and update contract. This supplies one exact coding construction; native acquisition, update, output and restoration costs remain unknown.
stop_rule: Stop at the first exact average-storage gain, its optimality proof and bounded certificate. Do not extend to higher ranks or claim a recursive saving.
